analytics.subtitle: Pipeline, attribution, scoring and CRM health
analytics.helpContactScore: Score from 0 to 100 combining 3 signals: Activity (opens, clicks, replies in last 30 days), Fit (how well the contact matches your ICP), and Status (pipeline position).
analytics.helpActivity: Points based on email opens, clicks, replies, and how recent the last interaction was (last 30 days).
analytics.helpFit: How well this contact matches your Ideal Customer Profile: sector, company size, job title.
analytics.helpChurn: Risk of losing this contact (0-100). Based on inactivity, stagnant deals, unanswered emails, and missing profile data.
analytics.helpForecast: Revenue forecast adjusted by win probability at each stage. A $10k deal at 50% probability = $5k weighted.
analytics.helpSalesCycle: Average number of days from first contact to closing a deal.
analytics.renewalsEmpty: No renewals detected. Contacts need a renewal_date or close_date in your CRM.
analytics.noTrendsData: Not enough historical data. Trends will appear after a few weeks of activity.
analytics.segmentSelectToView: Click a segment card to view contacts
analytics.engagementNoData: No engagement data yet. Activity will appear once emails are sent and tracked.
analytics.tabDescPipeline: Where are your contacts in the sales funnel? Track progression from first contact to close.
analytics.crmStagesHelp: Open deals broken down by stage, exactly as defined in your CRM and synced continuously. Amounts are the sum of deals in each stage.
analytics.crmStagesLostHelp: Last known stage of lost deals — the point in the pipeline where they died. Gets more precise as transitions are observed.
analytics.askHelp: Ask a free-form question: the answer is computed only from your CRM data (pipeline, stages, churn, forecast, activity). Nothing is made up.
analytics.askPlaceholder: Ask about your pipeline, clients, forecast…
analytics.askError: Analysis unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
analytics.askSuggest1: How is my pipeline doing right now?
analytics.askSuggest2: How many clients are at churn risk?
analytics.askDisclaimer: Answers computed from your CRM data only.
analytics.tabDescAttribution: Which campaigns drive the most conversions? See ROI by campaign and channel.
analytics.dealTouchHelp: A deal is "touched" once an agent email has actually been sent to it. Compare outcomes of touched deals vs untouched ones: that is your ROI proof.
analytics.dealTouchEmptyBody: {count} deals in your CRM have not received any agent email yet. Approve the pending drafts to start the loop — every send will show up here with its impact: reply, reactivation, deal won.
analytics.tabDescScoring: Unified score (0-100) combining activity, ICP fit, and pipeline status. Focus on the hottest contacts first.
analytics.tabDescTrends: How are your KPIs evolving week over week? Spot patterns in open rates, replies and more.
analytics.tabDescChannels: Email vs LinkedIn vs multi-channel — which channel performs best for your audience?
analytics.tabDescForecast: Revenue projections based on your pipeline. Weighted forecast and top deals to watch.
analytics.tabDescSegments: Your contacts grouped by behavior: champions, active, new, at-risk, dormant.
analytics.tabDescEngagement: How engaged are your contacts? Scored from 0-100 based on recent activity.
analytics.tabDescRenewals: Upcoming contract renewals and overdue ones. Never miss a renewal again.
analytics.tabDescHealth: Data quality audit: duplicates, missing fields, invalid emails. Clean your CRM in one click.
analytics.mfScenarioOptimisticSub: commit + probable deals at full value
analytics.mfContextReliable: Calibrated on your actual history: average cycle {days} days, win rate {winRate}%.
analytics.mfCalibrationOver: Learned correction applied: your past forecasts overestimated by {pct}%.
analytics.mfCalibrationUnder: Learned correction applied: your past forecasts underestimated by {pct}%.

signals.title: Signals
signals.subtitle: Detect buying signals and find the right prospects at the right time
signals.howStep1: baakalai monitors the web continuously (checks every 30 minutes): your configurations (funding rounds, hiring, leadership changes…) and your CRM accounts. Hot accounts — big deals, at-risk clients — are re-checked several times a day, and a deal moving in your CRM triggers a check within the half hour.
signals.howStep2: Every detected signal lands in this feed with its source and type — the Configuration tab controls what gets monitored, and "Run scan" forces an immediate check.
signals.howStep3: One click to act: add to CRM, send the suggested email, create a sequence, or dismiss. Nothing goes out without your approval.
signals.emptyFeed: No signals yet. The agent watches your CRM accounts every morning — detected signals will show up here.
signals.keywordsPh: Keywords to monitor (DeFi, exchange, wallet, NFT)
signals.emptyConfig: No config needed: your CRM accounts are watched automatically. Create one only to monitor other sectors or keywords.
